premise.title: Archive of Rain
premise.logline: In an archive of bottled weather, Nell brings Orin the last rain they have.

characters.name: Nell
characters.description: a young adult female archive courier with warm brown skin, short curly dark hair and a mustard-yellow jacket, on the LEFT holding a small glass rain jar in the warm-lit archive of bottled weather shown in the reference frame

characters.name: Orin
characters.description: an elderly male climate archivist with pale skin, swept-back silver hair, a clean-shaven face and a deep teal coat, on the RIGHT in the same warm-lit archive of bottled weather shown in the reference frame

script_lines.speaker: Nell
script_lines.text: This is the last rain we have.

script_lines.speaker: Orin
script_lines.text: Then don't spill a single drop.
